title: mut.feedback
mutation_directive: e9c is interesting — keep the line vocabulary. PUSH IT INTO 3D: the lines currently lie in a near-flat plane. Make them genuinely traverse depth — start in the foreground, sweep through to the background, vary z over their length. Use Line2 / LineSegments with explicit z-range = camera frustum-depth × 0.7. The viewer's parallax as the camera orbits should reveal genuine depth, not a flat sheet.

lia_halloran.praise: The slate-blue courier-dusk #6f8aa3 and the per-point dim jitter plus micro-grain give a faint painterly tremor I respect over procedural flatness.
lia_halloran.concern: This is the exact celestial cliché I reject: a midnight #14171c ground strewn with light-points — no white field, no blue-on-white, no actual brush-mark, just dots on dark.
lia_halloran.directive: Invert the value structure: pale ground, prussian-blue terrain, and render trails as variable-width painterly strokes whose density clusters into hand-drifted nebular masses, not an even 200×200 grid.

vera_molnar.praise: The nearest-neighbour route graph is a genuine rule — sites earn their edges by measured distance, not decoration. That axiomatic spine is the work.
vera_molnar.concern: The rnd() jitter scatters everywhere without an axis, and stacked sin/cos elevation plus two trail colors is decorative; your disorder has no direction.
vera_molnar.directive: Add one spatial entropy axis along z: foreground sites snap to a perfect grid, displacement growing linearly with depth — disorder you can read as you orbit.

manfred_mohr.praise: The deep z-span and orbiting parallax are real projection, not a painted backdrop — the couriers traverse computable space the camera genuinely reveals.
manfred_mohr.concern: The 'elevation' is faked trig terrain, not a computable transform, and fog, color-lerps and opacity fades are gradients everywhere — I want hard edges and rigor.
manfred_mohr.directive: Replace trig elevation with site positions projected from a rotating higher-dimensional lattice, kill the Fog gradient, and render routes as hard two-value LineSegments.

andy_lomas.praise: Couriers accumulating signal as they wander the route graph is close to deposition — traffic concentrating along paths is the right instinct.
andy_lomas.concern: Growth is purely additive: particles streak through space while the 200×200 terrain stays a fixed sheet. Nothing subdivides; the substrate never responds.
andy_lomas.directive: Where courier trails accumulate, locally subdivide the terrain point-grid — spawn finer points along heavily-trafficked routes so the mesh densifies by traffic, not a static 200² lattice.

casey_reas.praise: Agents leaving fading traces over a deterministic-hash route graph, no Perlin — this is the Process register, restraint and emergent local behaviour done right.
casey_reas.concern: The rnd() micro-jitter and random 2–4 neighbour count are noise, not rule; the amber #b98a5e against slate breaks your near-monochrome and reads warm-loud.
casey_reas.directive: Swap rnd() jitter and random neighbour-count for a deterministic local rule (angular-sector connection), and pull the ember toward the dusk-blue for true low-contrast monochrome.
